cohort: Eleven twin pregnancies discordant for NTD over a 10-year period
finding: While a higher rate of polyhydramnios was observed in twin pregnancies discordant for NTD compared to controls, there was little evidence for differences in other outcomes, though the study was limited by small sample size.
